title: Size the light sensor's divider
story: The night light's light sensor is a photoresistor (LDR) on top of a fixed resistor, powered from the microcontroller's 3.3 V. The decision point between the on and off thresholds is about 10 lux, where our LDR measures 10 kohm (shown here as a fixed 10 kohm resistor). Choose the fixed resistor so that at 10 lux the ADC sees between 1.5 and 1.8 V (the middle of its 0-3.3 V range, where it can tell small changes apart best), and the divider draws no more than 0.2 mA while it is switched on.

goals.label: sense between 1.5 and 1.8 V at 10 lux

hints: Equal resistors put the sense node at exactly half the supply.
